description: A UNESCO Global Geopark archipelago in the Japan Sea — sea-cliff pillars, a sacred 'flying' shrine island and slow island cycles.
notes: Dogo and Dōzen islands form the Oki chain: the charmed Kuniga coast on Dogo, the black-cliff shrine of Chichibugahama and cycle roads make it a two-day island escape from Matsue.
highlights: See the Kuniga coast sea-stack pillars
